brief: Plan a launch campaign for a budget fitness tracking app targeting college students. Budget is $2,000.
Plan a campaign to drive signups for a B2B project management SaaS webinar aimed at engineering managers at mid-size companies.
Plan a local marketing campaign for a new independent coffee shop opening in a college town, budget under $500.
Plan a holiday sale campaign for a direct-to-consumer sustainable sneaker brand, focused on Instagram and email.
Plan a year-end donor drive campaign for a small environmental nonprofit with a volunteer-run marketing team and no paid ad budget.
